description: Review dependencies for known CVEs, significantly outdated packages, license risks, and genuinely unused packages. Trigger on "are my dependencies safe", "check for vulnerable packages", "run a dependency audit", "do we have any GPL or AGPL dependencies", "any CVEs in our deps", "what can I safely remove from package.json". Produces a read-only report and changes no files — to actually plan and execute the version bumps and verify checks still pass, use upgrade-dependencies.
